evidence.claim: JWT tokens are stored in localStorage, making them vulnerable to XSS attacks
evidence.value: localStorage.getItem('access_token') used in frontend/src/lib/api.ts, frontend/src/app/login/page.tsx, frontend/src/app/register/page.tsx, frontend/src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx
evidence.notes: This affects 4+ files and is the highest priority security finding (P0)

evidence.claim: Default JWT secret is 'change-me-in-production' allowing token forgery
evidence.value: jwt_secret: str = 'change-me-in-production' in config.py; docker-compose uses JWT_SECRET: dev-secret-change-me
evidence.notes: P0 finding - allows complete authentication bypass if known

evidence.claim: No tenant isolation exists - all CRUD endpoints query without user_id filter
evidence.value: accounts.py, campaigns.py, groups.py, personas.py all execute queries like select(Account) without .where(Account.user_id == current_user.id)
evidence.notes: P1 finding - allows cross-tenant data access

evidence.claim: Nginx serves only HTTP on port 80 with no TLS, no security headers
evidence.value: nginx.conf: listen 80; no ssl_certificate directives; no X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS headers
evidence.notes: P1 finding - all traffic including credentials transmitted in plaintext

evidence.claim: 13+ analytics and admin endpoints return stub/fake data instead of real computations
evidence.value: analytics.py returns engagement_score: 0.0, funnel returns all zeros; advanced_analytics.py uses random.randint(); admin.py returns empty orders/deposits
evidence.notes: Backend gap - analytics computation not implemented

evidence.claim: Recharts imported directly in analytics page causing SSR hydration mismatch
evidence.value: analytics/page.tsx imports LineChart, PieChart directly from recharts without dynamic import with ssr:false
evidence.quote: import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, PieChart, Pie, Cell } from "recharts";

evidence.claim: Custom Dialog component lacks focus trap, allowing keyboard escape from modal
evidence.value: dialog.tsx has no onKeyDown handler, no focus trap, no aria-modal attribute, no role=dialog
evidence.quote: <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>

evidence.claim: No Order, Subscription, Deposit, or AuditLog models exist in the database schema
evidence.value: models/__init__.py defines: Account, Persona, User, TelegramGroup, Campaign, Conversation, AnalyticsRecord, EventLog. No Order, Subscription, Deposit, or AuditLog models.
evidence.notes: Backend gap - payment endpoints reference non-existent models

evidence.claim: No Celery worker configured in docker-compose despite async operation requirements
evidence.value: docker-compose.yml defines: postgres, redis, ollama, backend, frontend, nginx. No celery worker, no flower monitoring.
evidence.quote: services: postgres, redis, ollama, backend, frontend, nginx
evidence.notes: Infrastructure gap - async tasks run synchronously causing timeout risk
